18K likes, 252 comments - bruisedpassports on May 28, 2024: "Habibti 💗💫
Our holiday-home in Dubai is now available for you & your families to rent! It’s as central as it gets and ideal for a couple. You’ll see all details in the listing but here are some of my favourite things about it:

•5 min walk to Dubai Mall (through an air-conditioned building) 💫
•Great view of the Burj Khalifa 💫
•Fully functional kitchen, including a coffee machine 💫
•Pool and gym access included 💫
•Parking space included 💫

Can’t wait to see all your photos from here! 📸 Ending May with the fullest of hearts💗

Booking link in bio & @bruisedpassports_home 

#bruisedpassports #dubai".
